note: The narrow definition of child labor, excluding household chores, is based on economic activity only. The ILO and UNICEF use this definition for their headline child labor figures.
title: Child labor among girls and boys, under two different definitions
subtitle: Percentage of children aged 5–14 in child labor. The narrower definition (blue) counts only economic activity; the broader definition (red) also counts unpaid household chores, such as cooking, cleaning, and childcare, performed for at least 21 hours a week.
